## Ingredients

For the salad: 

- 2 can white beans 
- 1 can chickpeas 
- 1 bag corn 
- 1 can olives 
- 1/2 red onion 
- 1 Red bell pepper 

For  the Pesto: 

- 1/2 c almonds (blanched) 
- 1/8th c sunflower seeds (or more almonds)
- Basil (2 containers) 
- 6 cloves garlic 
- 4 TBS lemon juice 
- 1 TBS water 
- 3 TBS olive oil (we used oil from sundried tomatoes) plus 3 more TBS after it's blending to slowly drizzle in 
- 2 TBS nooch

## Instructions

Blend pesto 

Add to bowl with other ingredients 

Serve with chips

## Lisa's notes

Great if you stumble your way into having an abundance of basil.
